import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
import offline_discovery.rule_generate as G
G.BLOCK_ELEMENTS = 300   # force many blocks
from test_cluster import brute_clusters
random.seed(2024)
bad=0
for trial in range(120):
    fragments=[]

        L=random.randint(2,4); cls=random.randint(0,1)
        alphabet=[1000,1400,1515,1600,1800,2000,3028,900,1200,1490,1520]
        vals=tuple(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(L))
        fragments.append((0,0,L,cls,vals))
    eps=(random.choice([0,1,300,1000,1000000]),random.choice([1,3,1000]))
    ratio=(random.choice([0,1,2,5]),random.choice([1,2,3]))
